goal: Encapsulate transaction data behind observer functions to decouple internal representation from public API
Enable separating serialization and validation functionality from core transaction types in future refactors
agreement: Disputed with multiple open blocking objections on churn and lack of immediate benefit
Blocking objection: consensus-critical churn risks mutability footguns for no immediate gain (ajtowns)
Blocking objection: massive refactor across critical code without clear benefit (l0rinc)
Unaddressed objection: non-const members lose compiler checks enforcing initialization (maflcko)
Support for decoupling class layout from API and verified clang-tidy automation (josibake, alexanderwiederin)

categories.name: validation
why: P4 because it is an internal architectural cleanup offering no immediate performance or safety fixes
P4 because broader validation library separation efforts do not strictly depend on this change
